_what: Pendle's router on Robinhood Chain and the PT-USDG markets Priors trades through it, for buying, selling and redeeming PT-USDG (sdk/pendle-pt.mjs, gas-worker/gate.mjs, mcp-worker/tools.mjs, and the pages through scripts/build-site.mjs's generated pt-markets.js). From pendle-core-v2-public deployments/4663-core.json and the Pendle API, read 2026-10-05: the API's own routes for USDG to PT and PT to USDG on the 2027-03-25 market call swapExactTokenForPt (0xc81f847a) and swapExactPtForToken (0x594a88cc) on this router, with no outside aggregator.
_markets: Every market Priors trades or has traded, oldest first. status "active": bought and sold (until its expiry) and redeemed after it; at most one market is active. "redeem-only": a matured or retired market, redeemed only, after its expiry, so holders can always cash out through Priors. A new market is listed by adding its entry as active and setting the old one to redeem-only, never by editing addresses in place (docs/PT-USDG.md, "Rollover at maturity"). pyLpOracle: Pendle's PY/LP oracle for the market's spot rate (the top-level one unless the entry names its own).
_maxUsdgPerOp: The most USDG one sponsored buy may spend, and the most PT one sponsored sale may sell (6 decimals both): 2,000. The market moved 0.09% per 1,000 USDG and 0.76% per 10,000 on 2026-10-01 (reports/Pendle integration for Priors.md).
